description:
Use when someone wants a private deal or company scored and stress-tested for investors.
    Full underwriting chain on a deal profile: financial integrity → trend →
    industry position → stress tests → conviction score, plus a risk register and
    investment thesis (and an rNPV valuation band for biotech deals with
    `indications`). $2.00/call after free trial.

deal.description: Deal profile as a JSON object: the company, its industry, historical financials and projections (same shape as validate_financials input). Biotech deals may add an 'indications' list to get an rNPV valuation band.
deal.title: Deal
